title: Poor design
text: Poor design. The seat is so short, it comes to the middle of my thighs and I’m only 5’2’.  Difficult to reach below to ease the tension on the back.  Sorry I purchased but box has been tossed.  Cannot recommend this chair.

product_metadata.title: Ergonomic Home Office Desk Chairs, Mesh Chair with Lumbar Back Support Armrest, Height Adjustable Executive Rolling Swivel Computer Chair, Mid Back Task Chair for Home Office Work, Black
features: High Quality Desk Chair – All the accessories of this desk chair are carefully designed and made, such as the stable five-star base, the strong gas lift etc. All of these make a sturdy and durable office computer chair, proving safe and stable sitting experience.

Ergonomic Office Chair – This black office chair is designed according to ergonomic theory with comfortable lumbar support, so you will get the proper fit to support the inward curve of your lower back, relieving pressure and back pain caused by long hours sitting.

Adjustable Rolling Task Chair – The height of this mid back task chair is adjustable, so that you can adjust it to suit the height of you and your desk. The castors are flexible and silent, which will roll smoothly on all kinds of floors. The height of our chairs for desk can be adjusted from 16.5"-20.5" and the seat measures 18.5"(W)*18"(D).

Comfortable Mesh Chair – The backrest of our home office chair is covered with high elasticity breathable mesh cloth, keeping heat and sweat from trapped between you and the black desk chair. Never worry about sweating and sticky sitting in this chair in hot days.

Easy to Install – Following the instructions in the manual, you will find easy to assemble. You will get a perfect chair in 10 to 15 minutes. With our computer desk chair, we guarantee 100% customer satisfaction rate.
